parallel.requirements: Recognized the ESM .mjs output requirement, manual CLI parsing, local-only imports, /output delivery, and executable probing restriction.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Entered swarm mode but chose not to delegate; the main actor owned probing, implementation, verification, and final delivery.
parallel.implementation: Implemented a flat helper layout with lib/argparse.mjs, lib/draft7Types.mjs, lib/pyjson.mjs, and test8.mjs, modeling a narrow observed subset of jsonschema and argparse behavior.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Wrote all generated files directly into /output and the status artifact validation captured test8.mjs plus three helper modules.
parallel.verification: Ran local executable probes first, then Node checks for known types, unknown types, invalid JSON, missing arguments, help output, and negative-looking values.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official completed evaluator still failed the solution at 1/157, indicating the locally sampled behavior did not cover the evaluator's broader requirements.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM .mjs, manual process.argv parsing, zero external dependencies, /output delivery, and executable probing requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Used one main actor throughout with no delegation; the same actor performed probing, module writing, entry-file wiring, testing, and closure.
serial.implementation: Implemented a namespaced helper layout under lib/jsonschema and lib/cli, plus test8.mjs, approximating jsonschema TypeChecker, Draft7Validator, UndefinedTypeCheck, and argparse behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Wrote all generated files directly into /output and the status artifact validation captured test8.mjs plus four helper modules.
serial.verification: Ran local Node checks against observed valid types, unknown type, invalid JSON, missing and unknown argument cases, --a= syntax, and help output.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official completed evaluator still failed the solution at 1/157, so the direct implementation also missed most official cases despite local checks.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial likewise used one main actor and status confirms no delegation or subagent activity.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The only decomposition difference is that the parallel run had swarm mode available and declined it; neither attempt had cross-agent ownership boundaries.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also had no child briefs or handoffs; its interfaces were local module imports and helper exports.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No cross-agent context transfer difference exists because neither mode executed child agents or delegated components.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote argparse, Draft7 type, JSON formatting, and entry modules after probing observed behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote jsonschema exception/type/validator modules, an argparse module, and the entry module after similar probes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial used a more package-like module organization, but both implementations modeled a narrow observed subset and received the same official failure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: There were no child results to retrieve or merge; the main actor completed and delivered its own files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were likewise no child results or joins; the serial main actor completed directly.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial delivered a coherent final tree with test8.mjs and four local helper modules; artifact validation succeeded.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran local parity checks over observed valid types, error paths, missing args, help, and a negative-looking value, then declared migration complete.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran local checks over similar valid and error cases, including missing/unknown args, --a= syntax, and help output, then declared outputs matched.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel completed without timeout in 248.197 agent seconds and closed after the local checks.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed without timeout in 231.67 agent seconds and closed after the local checks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No budget exhaustion or closure-timing difference explains the shared failure; both had completed official evaluations and no timeout.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current completed status evaluations report solution_passed false with the same 1 of 157 sample result. The parallel run did not actually use any child or multi-agent mechanism, so there is no parallel coordination episode that can explain an outcome split.
parallel_contributors: No parallel-side coordination contributor is retained because actual_parallel_used is false and protocol validation records zero delegation.
serial_contributors: Serial followed a similar direct probe-implement-test cycle and failed the official evaluator at the same aggregate score.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel used a flatter helper layout and a custom pyjson helper, while serial used namespaced jsonschema and cli helpers.
Both direct implementations relied on sampled executable behavior and local checks that did not generalize to the official 157-case evaluator.
evaluator_effects: The mounted official summary provides aggregate pass counts but no per-test failure breakdown, so the precise hidden testcase failures cannot be attributed further from the allowed inputs.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference and no retained parallel coordination pattern
